headline.purpose: App name on the details page.

shadows.name: preview
shadows.purpose: Offset soft shadow on framed preview images.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Button and row hover ground transitions.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: White fill with dark ink on Nocturne, black fill with white ink on Daylight; the one primary action per state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: #ffffff; color: #16171b; font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e6e6e6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #cccccc; } .ds-btn-ic { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Transparent fill, one-pixel border; secondary actions and the uninstall half.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.075); background: transparent; color: #f4f4f6; font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #242424; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { background: #2a2d36; } .ds-btn-ic { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

components.name: Danger button
components.description: Filled bad color; used only after an inline confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: #ff6b70; color: #ffffff; font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #ff8286; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #d95a5e; } .ds-btn-ic { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

components.name: Icon button
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Refresh installed apps"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19.6 12a7.6 7.6 0 1 1-2.4-5.5"/><path d="M19.8 4.4v4.6h-4.6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 7px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #8a8f9f; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: #1d1d1d; color: #f4f4f6; } .ds-btn-icon:active { background: #242424; } .ds-btn-icon svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Panel ground pill stating one fact about an app.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.075); background: #161616; color: #8a8f9f; font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: State pill
components.description: Installed / Update ready status, tinted by state color.
components.css: .ds-state-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(89,211,155,0.14); color: #59d39b; font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; } .ds-state-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: #59d39b; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Field ground container with a one-pixel hairline.
components.html:
Go Mail
A focused IMAP and SMTP client.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1d1d1d; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.075); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 680; color: #f4f4f6; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a8f9f; }

components.name: App tile
components.description: 26%-radius square; theme-extreme fill (white on Nocturne, black on Daylight) with the line glyph, or the real icon read from the setup.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 26%; background: #ffffff; color: #16171b; } .ds-tile svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }

components.name: Nav item
components.description: 34px row, 9px radius, muted ink default, active on field ground.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #8a8f9f; font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(29,29,29,0.55); color: #f4f4f6; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #1d1d1d; color: #f4f4f6; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

narrative.overview: A storefront for a two-app suite, not a download page. The featured app owns the top of the stage with a real screen, and the suite index sits directly below. It refuses the category default of a whole page made of same-size icon cards and a wall of marketing copy. Nocturne ground, a sidebar on the ground, a stage panel at radius 18, cards at radius 12-14, theme-extreme accent (white on Nocturne, black on Daylight), Segoe UI, one-pixel white-alpha borders, offset soft shadows, a frameless window with the brand in the sidebar top and the window controls in the stage header.
keyCharacteristics: Storefront framing: one featured app with a real capture, then the suite index.
Honest copy: no ratings, prices, download counts, or invented claims.
State-driven actions: install, open, update, uninstall — one primary per state.
Nocturne by default, Auto and Daylight selectable, persisted locally.
Every preview is a real capture of the built program.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary accent appears on primary actions, the brand tile, focus rings, and selection only — never as a background wash or decorative stripe. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on framed previews, never on buttons, cards, or rows.

dos: Do use real captures for every preview; nothing is a mockup.
Do name every action by its result ("Install Go Post", "Open Go Post").
Do write status in words, not only color.
Do keep the accent rare; it carries the primary action.
Do persist the theme choice locally.
donts: Don't invent ratings, prices, download counts, or claims.
Don't add a separate titlebar; the brand lives in the sidebar top and the controls in the stage header.
Don't ship a modal for uninstall; use the two-step inline confirm.
Don't use a second typeface; Segoe UI carries everything.
Don't put shadows on buttons, cards, or rows.
